title: Lifecycle Hardening of Immutable Edge Appliances under Power and Connectivity Instability
abstract_snippet: Edge-based academic installations are typically unmonitored embedded appliances that are placed in an environment where infrastructure resources are limited. The ability to operate in these conditions is mainly related to the degree of reliability of the operating system and updates rather than the accuracy of the applications.
